matrix_description: A taxpayer with no blocking warning and no pending suggestion is ready to file.
assign_hint: Office members who see this taxpayer
taxpayers_description: Taxpayers this office serves and the team members assigned to them.
taxpayers_footnote: Assignments are kept in the demo store for now; they become persistent with the engagement and engagement_assignment endpoints (W1 #2). Adding a taxpayer will go through an invitation (D1b, D15).
invoices_description: Uploaded and collected e-invoice / e-archive records.
preview_source_xslt: Rendered in the browser with the invoice's own embedded XSLT. The permanent view will be rendered by the backend with go-ubltr.
preview_source_fallback: The invoice has no XSLT; a plain view was drawn from the record.
preview_fallback_banner: Preview drawn from the record · not the official view
warnings_description: Warnings raised by the checks. A period is not ready to file while blocking warnings are open.
warning.PENDING_RESPONSE: Commercial invoice is waiting for the buyer's accept / reject response.
warning.RETURNED: The invoice received a return response; decide how to book it.
warning.DELIVERY_ERROR: GİB / system error: the invoice may not be valid.
warning.PARTY_MISMATCH: Party tax ID does not match the taxpayer: expected {{expected}}, invoice has {{actual}}.
warning.UNKNOWN_TAX_CODE: Tax type not in the code list: {{value}}.
warning.LINE_TAXABLE_MISMATCH: Line amount does not match its VAT base.
warning.TAX_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Sum of line VAT ({{actual}}) differs from header VAT ({{expected}}).
warning.BASE_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Sum of line amounts ({{actual}}) differs from the invoice net ({{expected}}).
warning.PAYABLE_MISMATCH: Payable ({{actual}}) does not match net + tax − withholding ({{expected}}).
warning.HEADER_ESTIMATE: Invoice has no lines; VAT breakdown estimated from the header.
warning.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: Possible duplicate: invoice {{other}} has the same counterparty, date and amount.
warning.UBL_SCHEMATRON_FAIL: The invoice violates a GİB Schematron rule.
review_description: Account code suggestions below the {{threshold}}% confidence threshold. An approved code is written to the line.
review_empty_description: Every suggestion below the threshold has been decided.
review_decided_count: Decided suggestions (including automatic approvals above the threshold): {{count}}
reason.rule_keyword: line description matched a keyword in the rule set
upload_description: Upload e-invoice / e-archive UBL XML files, or a ZIP of them, on behalf of a taxpayer.
upload_drop: Drag files here or click to choose
upload_hint: .xml and .zip · the same ETTN is never added twice
upload_footnote: In demo mode files are parsed in the browser and basic amount checks run; XSD/Schematron validation arrives with the backend (go-ubltr). Added invoices:
studio.title: Review studio
studio.subtitle: {{left}} suggestions waiting · this session {{approved}} approved, {{rejected}} rejected
studio.ev_history_none: No approved decision for this code with this counterparty
studio.hint: Keyboard: J/K move, A approve, R reject, E code, Z undo
studio.done_body: You made {{count}} decisions this session. Nothing below the threshold is waiting.
studio.code_empty: No matching account. Type the full code (e.g. 770.01.012).
pulse.title: Period pulse · {{period}}
waterfall.title: Amount waterfall

waterfall.off: The payable on the invoice differs from the computed one by {{diff}}.
palette.title: Office command palette
palette.placeholder: Taxpayer name, tax ID or screen… (⌘J)
engagement_documents_page_description: Documents you can see for this taxpayer: the engagement period and any past data the taxpayer shared.
engagement_history_none: The taxpayer has not shared data from before the engagement; only documents from the engagement period are visible.
engagement_history_active: The taxpayer shared data from before the engagement: {{ranges}}
command.title: Command center
command.description: Taxpayer × period status: where is the work, who has it, what is it waiting for?
command.tip_regressed: A blocking warning was opened after this stage
command.regressed: {{count}} taxpayers got a blocking warning after the period moved on; recheck the cells outlined in red.
command.matrix_description: Furthest behind first. Status and warning filters apply to the selected period; click a column header to change it.
command.workflow_note: Collected and checked are computed from documents. Approved, exported and declared will be read from the period record once period management (#32) lands; for now they appear only in the demo office.
review_api.reverted_toast: Decision for {{code}} reverted; the line's code was restored
review_api.error_conflict: This suggestion is already decided or does not allow this action. The list was refreshed.
review_api.error_not_found: Suggestion not found; it may have been removed.
review_api.error_forbidden: You are not allowed to decide this suggestion.
review_api.plan_missing: No account plan is loaded or it could not be read; type the code.
review_api.undo_hint: Undo reverts the last approval or correction through the API; rejected suggestions cannot be undone.

warning.BNK_BALANCE_MISMATCH: Bank balance does not match the transactions

warning.BNK_POS_VS_SALES: POS collections do not match sales
warning.BNK_SALARY_VS_PAYROLL: Salary payments do not match payroll
warning.LOCKED_PERIOD_CHANGE: Change request for a locked period
warning.MISSING_AT_SOURCE: Record not found at the source
warning.PLATE_NOT_REGISTERED: Plate not registered to the taxpayer
warning.STATUS_UNMAPPED: Source status could not be mapped
warning.STATUS_UNVERIFIED: Document status could not be verified
warning.VAT_REPORT_MISMATCH: VAT report does not match the source
load_failed: Could not load the data. Refresh the page and try again.
taxpayers_empty: No taxpayers yet, or none assigned to you.
taxpayers_footnote_api: The list comes from active engagements. Without permission to see all taxpayers, only those assigned to you appear.
command.workflow_note_api: Status comes from period management: a locked period counts as approved; a period without open blocking warnings or change requests is ready. Ready does not mean documents have arrived: the matrix has no document counts yet. Exported and declared stages will follow once their sources are connected.
home_behind_description: Those with open blocking warnings or change requests first.
home_vat_description: Taxpayers with the highest estimated VAT payable; filing deadline and days left.
home_vat_unavailable: The VAT forecast is not available (you may lack permission).
home_vat_empty: No VAT forecast for this period.
api.load_error: Could not load the data. Refresh the page.
api.no_engagements: There is no active taxpayer you can see in this office.
api.upload_footnote: Files are processed on the server: XSD, GİB Schematron and duplicate check by ETTN. The report appears here when processing ends. Added invoices:
journals.title: Journal & export
journals.page_description: Prepare journal drafts, approve them and download the Luca / Zirve / Excel file.
journals.new_hint: Each line has an account code and only a debit or a credit. Entry numbers run per period; balance is checked at approval.
journals.export_description: Approved entries of {{period}} go into the chosen program's file.
errors.upload.unreadable: The file could not be read (damaged or not XML).
errors.upload.unsupported_document: This document type is not imported (e-Fatura / e-Arşiv invoices only).
errors.upload.xsd_invalid: Does not match the UBL-TR schema (XSD validation failed).
errors.upload.PARTY_MISMATCH: The taxpayer's VKN/TCKN is not on the invoice: it does not belong to this taxpayer.
errors.upload.mapping_failed: The invoice could not be read into the common model.
errors.upload.store_failed: The invoice could not be saved; try again.
errors.upload.unknown: The file could not be processed.
errors.upload.job_failed: The upload could not be processed. Check the file and upload it again.
errors.upload.held: Locked period: a change request was opened.
errors.api.NOTHING_TO_EXPORT: No approved entries to export. Approve entries of this period or reverse earlier exports.
errors.api.ALREADY_EXPORTED: This entry is already exported. Reverse it first to export it again.
errors.api.JOURNAL_UNBALANCED: The entry is not balanced: debits and credits must be equal.
errors.api.INVALID_DRAFT: Invalid entry: each line needs an account code and only a debit or a credit.
errors.api.REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for the reversal.
errors.api.UNKNOWN_DRIVER: The chosen program is not supported.
errors.api.INVALID_BODY: The request could not be read.
errors.api.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (200 MB at most).
errors.api.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Only XML, ZIP or base64 files can be uploaded.
errors.api.FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read.
errors.api.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.api.conflict: The record changed meanwhile; refresh the page.
errors.api.generic: The action could not be completed; try again.
errors.issue.ACCOUNT_NOT_IN_TARGET_PLAN: account {{account}} is not in the program's chart of accounts
errors.issue.JOURNAL_SPLIT_IMPOSSIBLE: the entry cannot be split to the {{max_lines}}-line limit ({{lines}} lines)
errors.issue.TEMPLATE_UNVERIFIED: the template was not checked against a real file
errors.issue.ENTRY_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: this program does not support the {{entry_type}} entry type
errors.issue.INVOICE_ENTRY_EXCLUDED: invoice entry left out (invoices reach the program through the integrator)
